history.p: In December 1884 the 200th anniversary of the Norwegian-Danish author and scholar, Ludvig Holberg was celebrated in Norway and Denmark with music by Edvard Grieg, Johan Svendsen, J.P.E. Hartmann, Emil Hartmann, August Winding, Frederik Rung, Axel Grandjean and Otto Malling. In a letter to the music teacher at Sorø Academy, Carl Emil Jæhnigen, Gade described "Holgergiana" as "en mindre Symphony i 4 Afdelinger " (a little symphony in four sections).

physLoc.identifier: C II, 6 Gades Samling 295 (Kapsel F - J)

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. Heading on p. 1: "Holbergiana". "Niels W. Gade. Op. 61" added in pencil. At the bottom of pp. 72-73 an extra stave has been added for a "Chor ad libitum" with the text: "Vivat Holberg!". After the final double-bar line on p. 74: "Fine / [Gade's musical signature] / Septbr. 1884." At the remaining part of page the choir has been written out in full.
